/** * Interface for handling channel messages in the Wurm mod loader system. * *
This listener provides hooks for intercepting and processing messages sent to various * communication channels including kingdom, village, and alliance channels. Implementations * can choose to process, modify, or block messages based on their content or context. * *
Usage example: * @code * public class MyMessageListener implements ChannelMessageListener { * @Override * public MessagePolicy onKingdomMessage(Message message) { * if (message.getMessage().contains("spam")) { * return MessagePolicy.DENY; // Block spam messages * } * return MessagePolicy.PASS; // Allow normal processing * } * } * @code * *
Thread Safety: Implementations should be thread-safe as message * processing may occur on multiple threads concurrently. * *
Lifecycle: Instances are typically registered during mod initialization * and remain active for the duration of the server session. * * @since 1.0.0 */

/**
	 * Handles messages sent to kingdom channels.
	 * 
	 * 
This method is invoked whenever a message is sent to a kingdom channel.
	 * Implementations can inspect the message content and metadata to determine
	 * how to handle the message.
	 * 
	 * 
Example usage:
	 * @code
	 * public MessagePolicy onKingdomMessage(Message message) {
	 *     // Log all kingdom messages containing "urgent"
	 *     if (message.getMessage().toLowerCase().contains("urgent")) {
	 *         logger.info("Urgent kingdom message: " + message.getMessage());
	 *     }
	 *     return MessagePolicy.PASS;
	 * }
	 * @code
	 * 
	 * @param message the message being sent to the kingdom channel
	 * @return MessagePolicy indicating how to handle the message (PASS, DENY, or INTERCEPT)
	 * @since 1.0.0
	 */

/**
	 * Handles messages sent to village channels.
	 * 
	 * 
This method is invoked whenever a message is sent to a specific village channel.
	 * The village context allows for village-specific message processing logic.
	 * 
	 * 
Example usage:
	 * @code
	 * public MessagePolicy onVillageMessage(Village village, Message message) {
	 *     // Block messages in newbie villages
	 *     if (village.isNewbieVillage()) {
	 *         return MessagePolicy.DENY;
	 *     }
	 *     return MessagePolicy.PASS;
	 * }
	 * @code
	 * 
	 * @param village the village the message is being sent to
	 * @param message the message being sent to the village channel
	 * @return MessagePolicy indicating how to handle the message (PASS, DENY, or INTERCEPT)
	 * @since 1.0.0
	 */

/**
	 * Handles messages sent to alliance channels.
	 * 
	 * 
This method is invoked whenever a message is sent to a PvP alliance channel.
	 * The alliance context provides information about the alliance sending or receiving
	 * the message.
	 * 
	 * 
Example usage:
	 * @code
	 * public MessagePolicy onAllianceMessage(PvPAlliance alliance, Message message) {
	 *     // Only allow officers to send messages to officer channel
	 *     if (alliance.isOfficerChannel() && !message.getSender().isOfficer()) {
	 *         return MessagePolicy.DENY;
	 *     }
	 *     return MessagePolicy.PASS;
	 * }
	 * @code
	 * 
	 * @param alliance the PvP alliance the message is being sent to
	 * @param message the message being sent to the alliance channel
	 * @return MessagePolicy indicating how to handle the message (PASS, DENY, or INTERCEPT)
	 * @since 1.0.0
	 */
